meta.title: IIT foundation classes in Pune for Class 9 and 10 | D-SAP
meta.description: A foundation programme for Class 9 and Class 10 students in Pune, before the two-year JEE programme. What it covers and who can join.

intro.text: A foundation programme for students in Class 9 and Class 10, before the two-year JEE programme begins.

body.text: Students in Class 9 or Class 10 who enjoy Maths and Science and want to build the habits JEE needs: steady practice, regular tests and asking for help early.

sections.heading: Age rules for coaching
body: The Ministry of Education's 2024 guidelines for coaching centres include rules on the age at which students can join. {{fact:legal.foundation-minimum-age}}

questions.q: When does my child move to the two-year programme?

a.text: After Class 10. The two-year programme starts in June, with a foundation period from April.

questions.q: Is the foundation programme needed before Class 11?

a.text: No. Any student who has passed Class 10 can join the two-year programme.
